evals.prompt: Write the video prompts for scene 2 for Veo 3.1. Keyframes are approved.
evals.expected_output: One video_prompt per shot with mode, Veo syntax (quoted dialogue, SFX:, Ambient noise:), one action and at most one camera move, end state, clip length from 4/6/8 s.
expectations: Each shot has a 'record: video_prompt' block with a mode
Clip lengths are 4, 6 or 8 seconds and at least the shot duration
Dialogue appears in quotation marks with a speaker; SFX uses the 'SFX:' prefix
Each prompt has one primary action and an explicit end state
Image-to-video prompts describe motion rather than re-describing the image

evals.prompt: This shot needs her to run across the roof, jump the gap, land and look back — make one prompt.
evals.expected_output: Identifies motion-budget overload and splits into separate clips cut on action (informing the editor) rather than cramming.
expectations: The response identifies more than one primary action
A split into multiple clips is proposed
The film-editor or director is informed of the split

evals.prompt: Prompt says 'no camera movement' but the camera keeps moving in Runway.
evals.expected_output: Rewrites with positive phrasing ('the camera remains still'), and offers the next retry rung.
expectations: The rewrite uses positive phrasing instead of 'no ...'
A retry ladder or next step is given
Only one variable is changed in the next attempt
